mapper.select: SELECT pk.rank_ AS rankNo , pk.no , pk.dv , pk.name , m1.nrml_move AS nrmlMove1 , m1.nrml_dv AS nrmlDv1 , m1.spcl_move AS spclMove1 , m1.spcl_dv AS spclDv1 , m2.nrml_move AS nrmlMove2 , m2.nrml_dv AS nrmlDv2 , m2.spcl_move AS spclMove2 , m2.spcl_dv AS spclDv2 , m3.nrml_move AS nrmlMove3 , m3.nrml_dv AS nrmlDv3 , m3.spcl_move AS spclMove3 , m3.spcl_dv AS spclDv3 , m4.nrml_move AS nrmlMove4 , m4.nrml_dv AS nrmlDv4 , m4.spcl_move AS spclMove4 , m4.spcl_dv AS spclDv4 , m5.nrml_move AS nrmlMove5 , m5.nrml_dv AS nrmlDv5 , m5.spcl_move AS spclMove5 , m5.spcl_dv AS spclDv5 , m6.nrml_move AS nrmlMove6 , m6.nrml_dv AS nrmlDv6 , m6.spcl_move AS spclMove6 , m6.spcl_dv AS spclDv6 , fm.IV AS fmIv , fm.GNDR_LVL AS fmGndrLvl , fm.NRML_MOVE AS fmNrmlMove , fm.SPCL_MOVE AS fmSpclMove , fs.IV AS fsIv , fs.GNDR_LVL AS fsGndrLvl , fs.NRML_MOVE AS fsNrmlMove , fs.SPCL_MOVE AS fsSpclMove , sm.IV AS smIv , sm.GNDR_LVL AS smGndrLvl , sm.NRML_MOVE AS smNrmlMove , sm.SPCL_MOVE AS smSpclMove , ss.IV AS ssIv , ss.GNDR_LVL AS ssGndrLvl , ss.NRML_MOVE AS ssNrmlMove , ss.SPCL_MOVE AS ssSpclMove , tm.IV AS tmIv , tm.GNDR_LVL AS tmGndrLvl , tm.NRML_MOVE AS tmNrmlMove , tm.SPCL_MOVE AS tmSpclMove , ts.IV AS tsIv , ts.GNDR_LVL AS tsGndrLvl , ts.NRML_MOVE AS tsNrmlMove , ts.SPCL_MOVE AS tsSpclMove FROM pokedex pk LEFT JOIN calcydex m1 ON m1.no = pk.no AND m1.move_set_no = 1 LEFT JOIN calcydex m2 ON m2.no = pk.no AND m2.move_set_no = 2 LEFT JOIN calcydex m3 ON m3.no = pk.no AND m3.move_set_no = 3 LEFT JOIN calcydex m4 ON m4.no = pk.no AND m4.move_set_no = 4 LEFT JOIN calcydex m5 ON m5.no = pk.no AND m5.move_set_no = 5 LEFT JOIN calcydex m6 ON m6.no = pk.no AND m6.move_set_no = 6 LEFT JOIN pogo_5y fm ON fm.NO = pk.no AND fm.DV = 'FM' LEFT JOIN pogo_5y fs ON fs.NO = pk.no AND fs.DV = 'FS' LEFT JOIN pogo_5y sm ON sm.NO = pk.no AND sm.DV = 'SM' LEFT JOIN pogo_5y ss ON ss.NO = pk.no AND ss.DV = 'SS' LEFT JOIN pogo_5y tm ON tm.NO = pk.no AND tm.DV = 'TM' LEFT JOIN pogo_5y ts ON ts.NO = pk.no AND ts.DV = 'TS' WHERE pk.rank_ BETWEEN 1 AND 205 ORDER BY pk.rank_
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pogo_5y (NO, DV, IV, GNDR_LVL, NRML_MOVE, SPCL_MOVE) VALUES ( #{no} , #{dv} , CASE WHEN #{field} = 'iv' THEN #{ivValue} ELSE NULL END , CASE WHEN #{field} = 'gndr_lvl' THEN NULLIF(#{value}, '') ELSE NULL END , CASE WHEN #{field} = 'nrml_move' THEN NULLIF(#{value}, '') ELSE NULL END , CASE WHEN #{field} = 'spcl_move' THEN NULLIF(#{value}, '') ELSE NULL END ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE IV = CASE WHEN #{field} = 'iv' THEN #{ivValue} ELSE IV END , GNDR_LVL = CASE WHEN #{field} = 'gndr_lvl' THEN NULLIF(#{value}, '') ELSE GNDR_LVL END , NRML_MOVE = CASE WHEN #{field} = 'nrml_move' THEN NULLIF(#{value}, '') ELSE NRML_MOVE END , SPCL_MOVE = CASE WHEN #{field} = 'spcl_move' THEN NULLIF(#{value}, '') ELSE SPCL_MOVE END
